title: Document Data-Extraction Models
outcome: 50 invoices checked in 1.4 s: 8 of 8 seeded errors caught, 0 false approvals.
summary: Accounts payable teams key supplier invoices by hand at about three minutes each. I built a Python agent that reads PDF invoices, checks them against vendor and PO master data, and only sends exceptions to a person, then mapped it to AI Builder, Power Automate, Dataverse and Copilot Studio.
cv: Inspired by: P&O integration analytics into governed single-source datasets.
